data.name: Beanos
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Beanopolis — a peaceful planet once filled with happy Beans, family gatherings, and absolutely no explosions.
That didn’t last.

An army of Bad Beans has launched a full-scale invasion, and now it’s up to the Good Beans to fight back. You may be small. You may be shaped like a capsule. But you are heavily armed, dangerously brave, and slightly unhinged.

💥 FAST-PACED BEAN COMBAT

Jump into chaotic, action-packed battles where teamwork is the difference between victory… and becoming mashed bean paste. Shoot, survive, and fight your way through waves of enemy Beans who are determined to take over the planet and everything on it.

🤝 SOLO OR 4-PLAYER CO-OP

Go in alone if you’re feeling heroic, or team up with up to 4 players in co-op mode. Coordinate attacks, cover each other, revive fallen teammates, and laugh as everything inevitably goes wrong.

🌍 EXPLORE FOUR UNIQUE BIOMES

Fight across four distinct biomes, each with its own look, mood, and challenges. From peaceful landscapes turned warzones to dangerous environments crawling with Bad Beans, every area pushes you to adapt and survive.

🌗 DYNAMIC DAY & NIGHT CYCLE

The planet doesn’t stop spinning just because there’s a war on. Experience dynamic day and night cycles that change visibility, atmosphere, and the feeling of every battle. Things get darker, scarier, and way more intense after sunset.

🫘 A PLANET WORTH SAVING

Beanopolis isn’t just a battlefield—it’s home. Thousands of Beans live here, with families, history, and a future worth protecting. Every fight is for the survival of your race and the planet you call home.

🔥 SIMPLE TO LEARN, HARD TO SURVIVE

Easy to pick up, but full of intense action, teamwork, and chaos. Whether you’re blasting enemies, holding the line with friends, or barely surviving another wave, every mission is packed with adrenaline and humor.

The Bad Beans want your planet.
You want them gone.

Suit up, grab your weapons, and fight back.
Save your race. Save Beanopolis. 🫘💣
